 CORAM:HONOURABLE THE CHIEF JUSTICE MRS. JUSTICE  SUNITA AGARWAL  and  HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PRANAV TRIVEDI  Date : 08/07/2024

ORAL ORDER (PER : HONOURABLE THE CHIEF JUSTICE MRS. JUSTICE SUNITA AGARWAL)
1. The instant petition, with the cognate matters has been filed with a prayer to issue direction to the respondents to deposit the compensation with the competent authority for the acquisition of lands in question and further to direct not to take over the possession or insist the petitioners to surrender possession unless and until the compensation amount is disbursed to them.
2.

The common ground taken in the writ petitions is that all the petitioners herein were owners in possession at the time of NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/9099/2020 ORDER DATED: 08/07/2024 undefined acquisition of the lands in question under the National Highways Act, 1956 (in short as "the Act' 1956").
Parmar Pratapbhai Malabhai vs The Union Of India on 8 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/159738358/

sentences.text: The award dated 12.01.2016/08.02.2016 under Section 3G of the Act' 1956 had been passed by the respondent No.3, namely the Competent Authority, National Highways Authority of India (in short as "the NHAI"), the petitioners being aggrieved by the award dated 12.01.2016, preferred arbitration application before the Arbitrator/ Collector under Section 3G of the Act' 1956.

The Collector had partially allowed the arbitration application vide order dated 03.04.2018 and remitted the matter back to the Competent Authority, namely the respondent No.3 for fresh consideration.

4. After the remand award dated 21.06.2018 had been passed by the respondent No.3, namely the Competent Authority, the petitioners again preferred an arbitration application No.99 of 2018 challenging the award dated 21.06.2018.

The Arbitrator, namely the Collector, Bhavnagar District had partially allowed the arbitration application preferred by the petitioner vide order dated 18.02.2019 modifying the compensation amount determined in the original award.

5. It is further stated that the notices for taking possession of the lands in question had been issued by the respondent, NHAI and actual physical possession of the lands in question had also been taken on different dates.

The submission is that the compensation determined under the original award passed by the competent authority in the year 2016 has also been NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/9099/2020 ORDER DATED: 08/07/2024 undefined received by the petitioners.

The only question remains is about the difference in the compensation amount determined by the Arbitrator vide order dated 18.02.2019 passed in the Arbitration Case No.99 of 2018 under Section 3G of the Act, 1956.

6. We may note, at this juncture, that the NHAI had filed applications under Section 34 of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 (in short as "the Act' 1996") challenging the arbitral award dated 18.02.2019, which applications have been dismissed on various dates between the year 2023 and till date.
The result is that the dispute pertaining to the validity of the arbitral award dated 18.02.2019 has been brought to its logical conclusion.
No further challenge has been made by the NHAI to the order passed under Section 34 of the Act' 1996.

7. In this scenario, all the connected writ petitions filed by the land owners are being disposed of with the observation that the petitioners shall approach the respondent No.3, namely the Competent Authority, National Highway Authority of India and Deputy Collector, Office of the Collectorate,
Near Motibaug, Bhavnagar for disbursement of the difference of the compensation amount between the original award and the award passed by the Arbitrator under Section 3G dated 18.02.2009.
8.

The petitioners, are, thus, required to make a appropriate application along with the copy of this order before the Competent Authority appending the document of their right, NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/9099/2020 ORDER DATED: 08/07/2024 undefined title or interest in the land in question,
due scrutiny/ verification of entitlement of the petitioners to receive the difference of compensation shall be made by the competent authority.

In any case, the entire exercise shall be completed within a period of one month from the date of receipt of the application, which shall be filed by the petitioners within the period of two weeks from today.
It goes without saying that the compensation would include the statutory interest.
